groups.name: PocketTTS model weights, tokenizer, voices and browser implementation
groups.license: CC-BY-4.0 Pocket asset set (ONNX export, tokenizer, metadata and 2 core voice states); Apache-2.0 browser code
groups.source: Kyutai Pocket TTS english_2026-04 checkpoint (model card kyutai/pocket-tts revision 75cfe24e3142233bb81887fed3482e9652bb4a6e, CC-BY-4.0). ONNX export, tokenizer.model, bos_before_voice.npy and bundle.json: KevinAHM/pocket-tts-onnx revision 58a6d00cf13d239b6748cb0769f35c580a8f606c, onnx/english_2026-04/, CC-BY-4.0 per the pinned onnx/LICENSE (SHA-256 fe7b4ce83b8381cc5b216bbb4af73c570688d1b819c73bbaed8ca401f4677cd6). Core voice states are Eve (the default) and Azelma, 2 of the 14 Kyutai precomputed states from kyutai/pocket-tts-without-voice-cloning revision 4e1e0a3e611c51c0b4ed8174fc10f32a54644303, languages/english_2026-04/embeddings/. The other 36 voices are installed at runtime, outside this package: the remaining 12 Kyutai states and 24 Animama-encoded states from Kyutai-enhanced CSTR VCTK Corpus clips (kyutai/tts-voices revision 323332d33f997de8394f24a193e1a76df720e01a, vctk/<speaker>_023_enhanced.wav; University of Edinburgh, CC-BY-4.0), published at https://downloads.animama.ai/models/pocket-tts-voices/<sha256>/<voice>.safetensors. All voice states are CC-BY-4.0; the recordings behind bill_boerst, caro_davy, javert and marius are CC0-1.0. notices/pocket-tts-attribution.txt names every voice and its source recording. Browser code and sentencepiece.js derive from KevinAHM/pocket-tts-web revision 3cf6daa623e2b09992c972cab32568ee8679a154; pocket-runtime.js ports the KevinAHM/pocket-tts-onnx reference runtime (Apache-2.0 code). CC-BY-4.0 permits commercial use with attribution; Kyutai's model-card prohibited-use terms still apply. The desktop release policy separately records a noncommercial distribution basis; changing it is a separate owner decision. This source record is not the final hash-bound inventory approval.
